record.source_closeout_reference: Authored during the mission in the Claude Code session executing the sponsor-approved long-running-mission gap plan; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Plan the three-rung duration ladder (roughly 1, 2, and 4 hours) supplying the V3-OP-003 decision-pack evidence, with checkpoint-level telemetry, mission-health signals at every checkpoint, the live-transport prerequisite for rung 2, and the formation/challenge-skill contract drafting folded into rung 3 as the V3-ANCHOR-005 named candidate trial.

envelope.reference: Sponsor agreement with the five-gap analysis and instruction to address the gaps in sequence starting with the next three or four bounded missions
envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no seeding events and relabeling them natural
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the ladder plan, registry rows, and README bullet
any wording implies a rung is approved or live transport may be used without its own gate
rung criteria are weakened to fit expected evidence
verification reports an unresolved advisory finding

verification.summary: Advisory lint, NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks passed on the first run after the edits; mission-record lint run after this record was authored.

notes: Docs-only plan with no new dependencies or code paths; each rung requires its own envelope and sponsor Go.
The do-not-seed-and-relabel rule keeps the natural negative-case evidence honest even if it delays the decision pack.
Checkpoint-level telemetry is framed as a trial question rather than a settled answer, consistent with Phase 3 overhead findings.
Scope stayed inside the ladder plan, two registry row updates, and the README bullet.
No rung execution, transport, or promotion scope was added.

friction_notes: Rung 2 has a hard dependency on the interrupt-transport trial passing first; if the transport trial stalls, the ladder stalls at rung 1, which the plan accepts rather than working around.
Rung 3's natural-interrupt requirement cannot be scheduled; the plan accepts that the negative-case gap may stay open after a clean rung 3.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Each rung tests exactly one new hard thing on top of the previous rung (mechanics, then duration plus live interrupt, then full duration plus natural events); this isolation makes failures diagnosable.
Folding the V3-ANCHOR-005 skill trial into rung 3 contract drafting gives two lanes evidence from one mission without expanding execution authority.
Failed rungs as first-class evidence with a two-failure design-review rule prevents both rung-skipping and silent retry loops.
